        <inscription>

        <inscription>
          <text>1</text>

      <arc id="a5" source="owned-transition-2" target="p2">

          <text>1</text>

    <finalmarkings>
      <marking>
        <place idref="p2">
          <text>1</text>
        </place>
      </marking>

  </net>
</pnml>

    <page id="page1">
      <place id="p0">
        <name><text>p0</text></name>
        <initialMarking><text>1</text></initialMarking>
      </place>

        <name><text>choice</text></name>
      </place>
      <place id="p2">
        <name><text>p2</text></name>
      </place>
      <transition id="owned-transition-0">
        <name><text>A</text></name>
      </transition>
      <transition id="owned-transition-1">
        <name><text>B</text></name>

      <transition id="owned-transition-2">
        <name><text>C</text></name>
      </transition>
      <arc id="a0" source="p0" target="owned-transition-0"/>
      <arc id="a1" source="owned-transition-0" target="choice"/>
      <arc id="a2" source="choice" target="owned-transition-1"/>
      <arc id="a3" source="owned-transition-1" target="p2"/>
      <arc id="a4" source="choice" target="owned-transition-2"/>
      <arc id="a5" source="owned-transition-2" target="p2"/>
    </page>
    <finalmarkings>
      <marking>
        <place idref="p2"><text>1</text></place>
      </marking>
    </finalmarkings>
  </net>
</pnml>
